claim: question-conditioned document-node binding and evidence repair under matched typed topology

permutation_protocol.dev_and_test: average the candidate score over all 24 document-alias permutations before ranking
permutation_protocol.train: sample one deterministic epoch-dependent S4 permutation per matched pair and apply it identically to the positive and negative members
permutation_protocol.unit_of_invariance: question, immutable document texts, and typed edges are relabeled together
permutation_protocol.why: prevents sequence position or neutral alias from becoming a label shortcut

training_objective.counterfactual_ranking: paired margin loss: score(question, positive binding) > score(question, target-swapped binding)
training_objective.forbidden_training_examples: T1, T2, fork, double-collider, natural retrieval errors, dev, and all-observed confirmatory pairs
training_objective.structured_repair: predict the two mention-edge endpoints that restore the positive binding from the counterfactual candidate
training_objective.total: ranking_loss + lambda_repair * repair_loss; lambda selected on train-only inner validation
